title: Q qualification requirement contract
purpose: Stable requirement identifiers for qualification slice Q, derived from docs/design/raster-data-analysis-rework.md (the six Q experiments and the Q exit artifact). The receipt refers to these identifiers instead of restating them. The evaluator decides Q eligibility from this contract; probe results cannot redefine it.

verdictDefinitions.pass: Every required assertion for the requirement has valid, matching evidence that meets its threshold.
verdictDefinitions.fail: Measured evidence violates the requirement, or the supplied evidence is malformed, inconsistent or corrupt.
verdictDefinitions.inconclusive: Required evidence is missing, was not run, is unsupported by the observation mechanism, or comes from an insufficient or wrong route or environment.
verdictDefinitions.notApplicable: The contract records no Q obligation for the requirement under the accepted plan, with a decision reason.

invariants: A passing negative control establishes expected rejection only; it can never satisfy a positive capability requirement.
A limitations string cannot waive a requirement. A requirement may leave Q scope only through an explicit decision recorded on that requirement in this contract.
Evidence must identify its route, artifact, fixture identity, environment, command and observation source. Missing identity makes the requirement inconclusive, never passing.
Synthetic evaluator fixtures prove gate behaviour only and are never qualification evidence.
A recorded requirement is either satisfied by evidence from the proposed route, or the overall verdict is not a pass.

requirements.title: Candidate artifact correspondence
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 1: record source commit, package version, artifact SHA-256, transitive lock, licenses/notices, APIs actually called, worker target and build commands. An inaccessible artifact, or an API available only in a different version, is not a pass.
requirements.unitsOrBudget: exact version, registry integrity digest, license, and source-commit correspondence per artifact
requirements.evidenceSource: q1-artifacts report from bootstrap_bench.py plus candidates.json

requirements.title: Scoped local numeric transport
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 2 and the Display contract: numeric windows read from local managed files via the intended Desktop/native/worker bridge; a remote HTTP demo or File.arrayBuffer() of the whole fixture does not qualify local access. Q must qualify the local bridge, not just HTTP COG access.
requirements.role: bounded numeric window decoding over the proposed local transport
requirements.fixtureClass: tiled COG derivative of a managed original
requirements.unitsOrBudget: window <= 1024x1024 cells; no single fetch may return the whole artifact; window values exact against an independent bounded reference
requirements.evidenceSource: q2-numeric verdict plus the transport's own byte ledger from the probe run
negativeControls: A stripped GeoTIFF is correctly rejected by the ranged decoder; this establishes expected rejection and does NOT satisfy a positive capability requirement.

requirements.title: Bounded preparation preserving originals
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 3: prepare tiled derivatives from the stripped inputs while preserving original hashes and sidecars.
requirements.role: native preparation of a managed original into a bounded, addressable derivative
requirements.unitsOrBudget: derivative tile size <= 1024; original bytes identical before and after

requirements.title: Resolved members and overview precedence
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 3: exercise the generation window interface against overlapping members and distant coverage; reprojection and reduction must use resolved accepted coverage, never let low-resolution source overviews resurrect replaced pixels.
requirements.role: generation resolution over ordered members, including replacement precedence
requirements.fixtureClass: multi-member collection with a real coverage gap
requirements.unitsOrBudget: windows spanning member boundaries fully covered; unoccupied slots zero coverage; later-member precedence exact
requirements.unresolvedFinding: R2-06: overview precedence is not exercised by any current probe.

requirements.title: Scientific values and exact validity
requirements.planBasis: Experiments 2 and 4: compare values and validity against independent bounded reference reads, including NoData, valid zero/negative values and boundaries; validity must match exactly. Degree and percent tolerances are specified by the plan.
requirements.role: numeric value and validity agreement against an independent reference
requirements.fixtureClass: analytic planes with NoData holes, including valid zero and negative samples
requirements.unitsOrBudget: Float32-representation tolerance for values; exact agreement for validity; slope within 0.001 degrees and 0.01 percentage points

requirements.title: CRS agreement
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 4: confirm selected EPSG:2154 control points agree with the independently configured GDAL reference within 0.1 m; record which component resolves CRS and how that interpretation reaches the decoder/display route.
requirements.role: CRS resolution and coordinate agreement for the proposed route
requirements.fixtureClass: the real fixture with the incomplete WKT
requirements.environment: qualification host, EPSG:2154 reference configured explicitly
requirements.unitsOrBudget: 0.1 m agreement against an independently configured reference

requirements.title: Active-operation cancellation on the proposed route
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 5: exercise cancellation during copy, read, preparation and slope; check no task is scheduled after cancellation, all owned handles/processes settle within 5 seconds. Cancellation should stop scheduling immediately and settle owned work within 5 seconds.
requirements.role: cancellation of genuinely concurrent work on the proposed route
requirements.unitsOrBudget: zero new work scheduled after cancel; settlement within 5 seconds
requirements.evidenceSource: q5-lifecycle verdict against the proposal's own operation
requirements.unresolvedFinding: R2-04: the current probe slices a resident in-memory buffer and counts completed operations, so it cannot qualify the WASM adapter's cancellation.

requirements.title: Owned worker teardown and resource release
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 5: partial initialization can be disposed twice safely; forced stalled worker/child termination with settlement within the bound; owned resources released.
requirements.role: teardown of an owned worker/child and the adapter that owns third-party handles
requirements.fixtureClass: proposed route under load, including a stalled child
requirements.unitsOrBudget: repeated dispose is safe and observably releases resources; a stalled child terminates and settles within 5 seconds

requirements.title: Required failure injection
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 5: force a stalled worker/child, decode failure and disk write failure; partial initialization disposed twice safely.
requirements.role: failure handling on the proposed route
requirements.unitsOrBudget: each injected failure is rejected with a named reason; nothing silently succeeds

requirements.title: Local Desktop worker and asset hosting without network
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 5: use the intended bundled worker/asset path in the local Desktop WebView without network. Experiment 6 and the verification section: browser/jsdom success does not establish WebKit behaviour or packaged WASM loading.
requirements.role: the intended Desktop host: bundled worker and asset path, no network
requirements.unitsOrBudget: assets load from the bundle with no network origin; the worker path is the intended one

hostEvidenceRules.reason: Chromium and Node runs cannot satisfy the plan's Desktop WebView requirement, and packaged cross-platform distribution remains a later release gate.

requirements.unresolvedFinding: R2-06: no Desktop WebView host evidence exists; all current evidence is Chromium.

requirements.title: Route-level resource measurement
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 6: measure the native host's incremental RSS above an idle baseline and all raster child/worker processes, with 100 ms samples plus available OS high-water marks and instrumented allocator/queue bounds; record temporary disk high-water, decoded-cache bytes, active reads, queue depth and child count. Reserve 128 MiB total for decoded numeric/display caches and 512 MiB on disk for reproducible display cache.
requirements.role: the measured route's own resource use
requirements.fixtureClass: capacity fixture exercised through the proposed route
requirements.unitsOrBudget: combined raster worker/process working memory <= 1 GiB excluding the idle app baseline; decoded cache <= 128 MiB; display cache <= 512 MiB on disk; 100 ms sampling
requirements.unresolvedFinding: R2-06: current candidate-route evidence records request bytes only; memory is measured for the reference reader, so candidate memory is missing.

requirements.title: Route-level display measurement
requirements.planBasis: Experiment 6: replay a fixed viewport trace with at least 100 tile requests in each cold/warm run, specifying which caches were cleared; compute p95 from individual tile latencies, not four aggregate runs. Memory bounds, responsive cancellation, correctness, and no UI-thread raster compute above 50 ms are release gates.
requirements.role: display tiles produced by the proposed route
requirements.unitsOrBudget: at least one cold and three warm runs; >= 100 valid individual tile latencies per run; no UI-thread raster compute above 50 ms
requirements.evidenceSource: q6-resources verdict against the display trace report

laterReleaseGates.title: Cross-platform packaged distribution
laterReleaseGates.reason: The plan assigns packaged cross-platform distribution and the Linux/Windows/macOS artifact matrix to slice F. macOS and Windows absence does not make Q inconclusive, but no Q result may be reported as cross-platform support.

laterReleaseGates.title: 48-million-cell real batch import
laterReleaseGates.reason: The plan assigns real batch import and reopen within resource gates to N2. Q establishes feasibility on synthetic and recorded fixtures.
